basic_details.short_information: Telecom Regulatory Authority of India (TRAI), New Delhi has released a recruitment notification for filling up the post of Advisor at its Regional Office Delhi on deputation on foreign service terms. Eligible officers from Central Government, State Governments, Union territory Administrations, autonomous bodies, statutory organisations, public sector undertakings, recognised universities, or recognised research institutions may apply through online mode only at https://vacancies.trai.gov.in. content_sections.text: The official notification specifies the post name, pay scale, eligibility criteria, and application deadline, but does not mention any application fee or written examination details.

content_sections.heading: About TRAI Advisor
content_sections.text: Telecom Regulatory Authority of India (TRAI), located at World Trade Centre, Tower-F, Nauroji Nagar, New Delhi - 110029, is a statutory body established under the TRAI Act, 1997. It regulates telecommunications services, protects the interests of consumers and service providers, ensures orderly sector growth, and manages broadcasting and cable services sectors.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Applicants must first apply through the online mode at https://vacancies.trai.gov.in. After online submission, candidates must forward the duly attested hard copy of the filled online application form (downloaded from https://vacancies.trai.gov.in) along with attested copies of ACRs/APARs for the last five years, vigilance/disciplinary clearance, and cadre clearance. The application should be sent in an envelope superscribing the post applied for to: Senior Research Officer (HR), Telecom Regulatory Authority of India, World Trade Centre, 6th Floor, Tower-F, Nauroji Nagar, New Delhi-110029 on or before 11 November 2026. content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Officers of the Central Government or State Governments or Union territory Administrations or autonomous bodies or statutory organisations or public sector undertakings or recognised universities or recognised research institutions must meet the following criteria: Holding analogous post on regular basis in the parent cadre or department; or With four years of service rendered after appointment to the post on regular basis in level-13 in the pay matrix (Rs. 123100-215900) or equivalent, in the parent cadre or department; or With seventeen years of regular service in Group 'A' and have held a post in level-12 in the pay matrix (Rs. 78800-209200) or equivalent on regular basis for a period of not less than seven years. Candidates must possess a Bachelor's degree from a recognised university or institute, and fifteen years of experience in the field of telecommunications, industry, finance, accountancy, law, management, or consumer affairs. Note: Preference shall be given to candidates holding senior management positions. The maximum age for appointment on deputation shall in no case exceed 58 years on the last date of receipt of applications in TRAI.

rows.pay: Pay Level-14 (Rs. 144200-218200 in Pay Matrix as per 7th CPC) plus allowances

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Duly attested hard copy of filled online application form downloaded from https://vacancies.trai.gov.in Attested copies of ACRs/APARs for the last five years Vigilance and disciplinary clearance Cadre clearance

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Appointments will be made on deputation on foreign service terms, initially for a period of three years or till superannuation, whichever is earlier. Eligible candidates whose services could be placed at the disposal of the Authority immediately in the event of selection will be considered.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The appointment is governed by the instructions issued by the DoP&Trg. OM No. 6/8/2009-Estt. (Pay II) dated 17 June 2010, as amended from time to time. Applications must be submitted through online mode only on the designated portal before sending the hard copy. Incomplete applications or hard copies received after the last date will not be considered. Services of selected candidates must be available for immediate placement at the disposal of the Authority. The envelope containing the application must be superscribed with the name of the post applied for.

faq.question: Q1. What is the name of the post advertised?
faq.answer: The advertised post is Advisor, Regional Office Delhi.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date to submit online applications and forward the hard copy to TRAI is 11 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the pay scale for the TRAI Advisor post?
faq.answer: The post carries Pay Level-14 with a pay scale of Rs. 144200-218200 in the Pay Matrix as per 7th CPC plus allowances such as DA and HRA.

faq.question: Q4. What is the maximum age limit for appointment?
faq.answer: The maximum age for appointment on deputation shall in no case exceed 58 years on the last date of receipt of applications in TRAI.

faq.question: Q5. What educational qualification is required?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Bachelor's degree from a recognised university or institute along with 15 years of experience in telecommunications, industry, finance, accountancy, law, management, or consumer affairs.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: Candidates must apply through online mode at https://vacancies.trai.gov.in and send the duly attested hard copy by post.

faq.question: Q7. What is the initial duration of the appointment?
faq.answer: The appointment on deputation on foreign service terms is initially for a period of three years or till superannuation, whichever is earlier.
